integrity: Every raw signing of K3, K4, and K5 is enumerated. Triangle imbalance is computed directly; frustration is independently reconstructed by exhaustive vertex bipartitions and exhaustive switching; switching classes are normalized and quotient-checked under all vertex permutations through their unbalanced-triangle patterns.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete finite simple undirected signed networks and compares strict ordinal rankings induced by the triangle index and normalized frustration index. The exact classification stops at five vertices, the first reversal order, and does not cover sparse networks or other partial-balance measures.
title: Five actors are the first strict rank reversal between triangle balance and frustration balance
